_source: Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra, tr. R. Santhanam, Vol. 1 (Ranjan Publications, New Delhi, 1992), Ch 34 'Yoga Karakas', verses 19-44: Parasara's per-lagna lists. Read in the archive.org full text of item heag_brihat-parasara-hora-sastra-vol-1-by-maharshi-parasara-commentary-editor-tr; the Libra and Scorpio verses were also checked on the page images (leaves n356, n357). Pages are the printed page numbers from the running heads; the English translation of each verse starts on the first page given.
_schema: Lists hold lowercase graha keys exactly as the verse names them. 'benefic' = called auspicious; 'malefic' = called malefic or inauspicious; 'neutral' = called neutral, mixed or 'according to association'; 'yogakaraka' = named as causing (raja)yoga by itself; 'maraka' = named as killer. A planet the verse does not classify is absent: functional.py then uses the generic Ch 34 rules for it (source 'rule'). Notes paraphrase conditions the verse attaches.

notes.mars: Though lord of the 8th, Mars helps the other auspicious planets.
notes.jupiter: A mere Saturn-Jupiter conjunction gives no auspicious result; Jupiter under a malefic's control turns inauspicious.
notes.venus: Venus is a direct (independent) killer; Saturn and others kill if associated with him.

notes.maraka: 'Jupiter etc. and Mars will inflict death'; Santhanam reads 'Jupiter etc.' as Jupiter, the Moon and Venus.

notes.saturn: No classification in the verse (Santhanam: 'there is no hint on Saturn'); a Saturn-Jupiter conjunction gives no yoga, as for Mesha.
notes.moon: The prime killer, depending on her association.
notes.mercury: The lagna lord is not classified in the verse.

notes.saturn: Killer, giving effects according to association.
notes.sun: Killer, giving effects according to association.

notes.jupiter: A Jupiter-Venus conjunction (kendra and kona lords) gives no auspicious result.

notes.venus: A Venus-Mercury conjunction produces yoga; Venus is also a killer.
notes.sun: His role depends on his association.

notes.moon: The Moon and Mercury ('chandra-tat-sutau', page image checked) cause rajayoga.
notes.venus: The lagna lord is called neutral (he also owns the 8th).
notes.mars: Mars kills; Jupiter and the other malefics acquire maraka qualities.
